description: CACC Field Operational Test 2018 Noord Holland; cooperative and automated driving for intelligent traffic signal corridors is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Simeon Calvert. A Field-Operational-Test (FOT) with CACC vehicles and wireless communication with intelligent intersections on arterial roads was performed in autumn 2018, initiated by the Province of Noord-Holland in The Netherlands. Coverage: national (NL); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. Formats: Excel. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
